pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
Leaning before I can say it.
I write A Lean, Not a Fall in the margin and close the page.
The piano says leaning before I can say it more quietly than I do.

[Pre-Chorus]
I stay with A Lean, Not a Fall and do not rename it.
The evening keeps A Lean, Not a Fall and nothing larger.

[Chorus]
Soft keys underline A Lean, Not a Fall and then rest.
I leave A Lean, Not a Fall where the light already was.
Leaning before I can say it, and the cup stays where I set it.

[Verse 2]
A Lean, Not a Fall is only the name I give this hour.
Leaning before I can say it.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
The piano says leaning before I can say it more quietly than I do.
I stay with A Lean, Not a Fall and do not rename it.

[Chorus]
Soft keys underline A Lean, Not a Fall and then rest.
I leave A Lean, Not a Fall where the light already was.
Leaning before I can say it, and the cup stays where I set it.

[Outro]
(solo piano fades into soft residual notes)
I write A Lean, Not a Fall in the margin and close the page.
